fixes.explanation: That's right, baker. Peter says the holy women of the past "…put their hope in God…" (1 Peter 3:5). That's where their hope went, and it's the best place to park yours too. Hope parked anywhere else gets towed.

Good guess, friend, but anger isn't the word in this line. Peter says they are Sarah's children "…if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear." (1 Peter 3:6). The thing to refuse here is fear. Fear can get LOUD, but it doesn't get the last word.

Wisdom is a fine thing to chase, friend, but that's not the word here. The quote says "…the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer." (1 Peter 3:12). So it's the righteous whose prayer He leans in to hear. I think that's a pretty comforting picture, honestly.
